semantic_summary.one_sentence_summary: The vocal recording consists of 23 vocal phrases grouped mainly into two primary melodic motifs centered around G3, exhibiting predominantly descending and mostly flat pitch contours with variable phrase durations and low vocal cycle tempo stability.
semantic_summary.structure_description: The structure includes 23 phrases divided into short calls, compact, extended, and standard phrases, separated by 7 pauses of varying durations. Phrase durations vary widely (mean ~8.7s, median ~4.0s), and pauses are generally short (mean ~1.6s). Vocal density is high with low silence density; cycle tempo is about 27 bpm but with low stability.
semantic_summary.dominant_pattern: Two main motifs are identified: one descending motif repeated 10 times with longer duration (~16.9s), and one ascending motif repeated 3 times with shorter duration (~1.87s), together covering about 68% of clean phrases. Pitch contours are mostly descending or flat with small pitch span around tonal center G3.
uncertainty_notes: Cycle tempo confidence is low, indicating unstable timing.
